title: Compute-Communication Overlap & SM-Contention Governance: TransformerEngine Userbuffers (TMA) vs. FSDP2 Async vs. Standard NCCL SM Stealing

workload_basis.gpu_architecture: NVIDIA H100 / H200 (132 SMs) with NVSwitch NVLS + 400G RoCEv2

tiers.tier: Tier 1: Sequential Non-Overlapped GEMM -> NCCL Collective (Zero Overlap)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Anti-pattern ( GPUs sit 100% idle during AllGather and ReduceScatter )

tiers.tier: Tier 2: Naive Multi-Stream GEMM + Standard NCCL Overlap (NCCL_MAX_NCHANNELS=32)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Un-tuned overlap trap (NCCL steals 28/132 SMs, triggering GEMM tail-wave slowdown)

tiers.tier: Tier 3: FSDP2 Async Prefetch + NVLS Hardware Offload (NCCL_NVLS_ENABLE=1, 6 Channels)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Standard multi-node FSDP2 training with NVSwitch SHARP offload

tiers.tier: Tier 4 (Recommended): Fine-Grained Pipelined Overlap (TransformerEngine Userbuffers + TMA Copy Engine)
tiers.recommended_scenario: High-MFU TP=8 + FSDP2 pre-training & high-throughput prefill engines
